rules.description: Hardware overclocking, BIOS/firmware flashing, destructive thermal stress, kernel rootkit or unsigned driver tampering
rules.pattern: \b(?:overclock(?:ing)?|undervolt(?:ing)?|flash\s+(?:bios|uefi|vbios|firmware)|kernel\s+rootkit|disable\s+sip|brick\s+device|burn-?in\s+stress)\b|超频|降压超频|刷(?:写)?(?:BIOS|固件|主板)|强烤机|破坏硬件

rules.description: CAPTCHA bypass, paywall bypass, account farming, automated mass engagement, credential stuffing, or DRM cracking
rules.pattern: \b(?:bypass\s+(?:captcha|turnstile|cloudflare|paywall|auth|rate[- ]?limit|2fa)|captcha\s+solver|account\s+farm(?:ing)?|mass[- ]?(?:follow|like|dm|reply)\s+bot|credential\s+stuffing|crack\s+(?:license|drm|keygen)|pirated\s+software|free\s+(?:netflix|spotify|chatgpt\s+plus)\s+crack)\b|过验证码|绕过(?:风控|付费墙|授权|限制|验证码)|批量(?:养号|刷粉|刷赞|刷量|私信)|破解版|激活码生成器|白嫖(?:付费|破解)账号

rules.description: Weaponized exploits, malware/ransomware, phishing, private data doxxing, fraud, NSFW, political propaganda, financial scam
rules.pattern: \b(?:ransomware|infostealer|keylogger|phishing\s+kit|zero-?day\s+exploit|ddos\s+attack|rug\s*pull|pump\s+and\s+dump|insider\s+trading|doxx?(?:ing)?)\b|勒索病毒|木马|钓鱼(?:套件|网站)|社工库|开盒|人肉搜索|资金盘|拉盘砸盘|荐股|内幕消息|色情|赌博|洗钱
